full_judgment: 9. The judgment and decree impugned before the High Court Division was the judgment and decree of reversal, so it was its incumbent duty to see whether the Appellate Court being the last Court of fact adverted to the findings of the trial Court in reversing its judgment and decree. Let us see whether the High Court Division did the said job in setting aside the judgment and decree of the Appellate Court and restoring those of the trial Court.
